conviction_note: The print is almost certainly the FY26 Annual Report. It is a non-event for an explorer whose 30 June cash ($37.2M) and H2 2026 DFS guidance were disclosed in the 29 July 5B, and whose A$60M placement on 21 Sep was already marked down 14.7% over five sessions. The only dated in-window item is the second session of trading for 183.6M Tranche 1 placement shares, which were allotted 28 Sep and sit about 5% under their A$0.305 issue price. I size that small and negative. It cuts mildly against the +1.34 reversal lean, which I do not add to the number.
bar: Company's own last statements: cash at bank $37.2M at 30 June 2026 and Tabba Tabba DFS 'scheduled for completion during H2 2026' (Quarterly Activities/Appendix 5B, 29 Jul 2026, https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260729/pdf/0724vk22lw03ty.pdf). Placement reiterates 'deliver the DFS later this year' (https://announcements.asx.com.au/asxpdf/20260921/pdf/0749r4cd8q2t2c.pdf). No street consensus exists, so every size is capped small. The annual report restates audited June-year numbers already carried by the June-quarter 5B, so the bar is met by construction.
filer_type_check: The baseline says quarterly_report_only. That is a classifier miss rather than a fact. WC8 lodges its statutory periodic reports under headlines that carry no 4D/4E vocabulary: 'Half Yearly Report and Accounts' (10 Mar 2026 17:37, 12 Mar 2025, 15 Mar 2024) and 'Annual Report to shareholders' (23 Sep 2025 16:46, 26 Sep 2024 17:55). The 28 Sep amc vendor row fits the FY26 Annual Report, which is due by 30 Sep. For a pre-revenue explorer that document is the cash-flow bar and not a profit result, so I hunted the 5B cash, the DFS timing and the financing instead. Next-day reactions to the last two annual reports were +8.00% (2024-09-27) and -2.44% (2025-09-24), about the size of ordinary noise at 77% realised vol.
event_check: Confirmed as real and due, but not to the exact day. The ASX archive shows no FY26 annual report lodged as of 2026-09-27; the latest WC8 item is the 21 Sep placement (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=WC8&timeframe=Y&year=2026). The statutory deadline is 30 Sep, and prior annual reports landed 23 Sep 2025 and 26 Sep 2024, both after the close (https://www.asx.com.au/asx/v2/statistics/announcements.do?by=asxCode&asxCode=WC8&timeframe=Y&year=2025, ...&year=2024). A 28 Sep amc or 29 Sep intraday lodgement falls inside the window. A 30 Sep lodgement would fall outside it, which is immaterial because the document carries nothing new. The next Appendix 5B quarterly (Sep quarter) is due in October (last year 9 Oct), outside the window.
session_check: amc. It fits the company's own history: the last two annual reports were lodged at 16:46 and 17:55 Sydney time (ASX archive 2025 and 2024 pages above). The exact 28 Sep date is the vendor's and is not verified.
positioning_check: ASIC aggregate short is 0.5172% as of 2026-09-21 (7.29M shares), up from 0.368% on 2026-09-14, published with a 4-session lag. The build coincides with the placement book being priced (trading halt 18 Sep, placement 21 Sep), so it reads as some placees hedging rather than a directional short. It is tiny: 7.3M shares against 183.6M Tranche 1 shares, so there is no squeeze fuel. Most of the hedge is extinguished by delivery at allotment, not by buying.

findings.finding: Tranche 1 of the A$60M placement is 183,606,558 new shares, about 13% of the register, issued at A$0.305. Settlement was 25 Sep and allotment and trading begin Mon 28 Sep, so the window (close 28 Sep to close 29 Sep) is the second session of that paper trading. The stock closed 25 Sep at A$0.29, about 4.9% under the issue price.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The announcement day, 21 Sep 2026, closed -14.7% (0.34 to 0.29) on 18.3M shares, and 22 Sep traded 19.4M shares. The name then drifted from 0.32 back to 0.29 by 25 Sep. There is no prior placement-allotment day in this name I could cleanly isolate.
findings.why_not_priced: The timetable is public and the price already trades below the issue price, so most of this is priced. The only residual is second-day supply from any placee who exits underwater. If the market had fully cleared it, the stock would be holding at or above A$0.305 into allotment rather than printing a fresh low of 0.29 on 25 Sep, the day before the shares became tradeable. Against that, the company describes the book as long-only specialist resources funds, which flip less, and underwater holders are slower sellers. Hence the small size and wide band.
findings.independence: The terms are corroborated by independent secondary coverage of the same document (https://discoveryalert.com/asx-stock-news/mining/wc8-wildcat-resources-tabba-tabba-a60m-placement/), but that is not independent evidence of the reaction. The 25 Sep close is from https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/WC8.AX?range=3mo&interval=1d.

outside_window.finding: The Tabba Tabba DFS is guided for H2 2026 ('later this year' in the placement). It is the name's real catalyst, but I found no evidence it lands 28-29 Sep, and a company that has just raised pre-DFS is unlikely to drop it inside a week.
The maiden Bolt Cutter Central Mineral Resource is targeted for Q4 2026.
Tranche 2 is 13,114,754 shares subject to a general meeting in November 2026.

baseline_tension: The lean is +1.34, driven by the -26.6% 20-day and -14.7% 5-day run-up (reversal). My one finding is a mild in-window supply headwind that cuts against it, but it is small enough that neither dominates.
